name: postgres
title: PostgreSQL
description: A PostgreSQL 17 database on a volume, backed up daily, with Adminer to look into it.
notes: Adminer is at https://{{domain}}, behind Team only: its user name is team, and its password is shown once after Create. To log into the database from Adminer choose System PostgreSQL, Server postgres, Username app, Database app, and the password you typed. Other apps of this project and environment reach the database at <app name>-postgres:5432, so postgres-postgres:5432 if you keep the app name postgres (Adminer has a port too, so the bare app name isn't claimed), with Username app and Database app; the installed notice shows the exact address. That needs a Caravana whose installed notice lists addresses: on an older one other apps can't reach it by name, so add your own services to this app's Compose file (Configure, Compose), where they reach it at postgres:5432. Backups run every day at 03:00 UTC.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Adminer domain
inputs.help: Where Adminer is served. Its DNS must point at this server.

inputs.name: db_password
inputs.label: Database password
inputs.help: The password of the app user. Keep a note of it: Caravana never shows it again.
